purpose: Grade a firm EMIR Refit reporting readiness across five dimensions: ISO 20022 format cutover, UPI sourcing via ANNA DSB, UTI sharing SLA (10:00 CET T+1), reconciliation tolerance configuration (148-field set, 2026 escalation), and lifecycle action-type controls. Returns an A-F grade and a gap list. Terminal node of the emir-reconciliation-and-lifecycle chain; exports readiness attestation with execution_hash.
